candidates.name: S-R150-P100-G200
text: Up to 200 candidates per query, all statistics from the history before A.
Main retailer of the user: the retailer with the most distinct orders of the user; ties by the later last order of the user there, then by retailer code.

(a) repeat: the distinct products the user bought before A, by the number of distinct orders with the product descending, then the time of the latest such order descending, then product_id; the first 150.
(b) pop-retailer: products by distinct buyers at the main retailer in [A - 28 days, A) descending, then product_id; the first 100.
(c) global: products by distinct buyers over all orders in [A - 28 days, A) descending, then product_id.
Union: (a) in its order, then (b) without (a), then (c) without (a) and (b), until exactly 200 candidates. Source ranks repeat_rank, popr_rank and glob_rank are positions in the full orders.

features.name: up_orders
features.formula: number of distinct orders of the user before A that contain the product (repeated lines of an order count once)

features.name: up_share
features.formula: up_orders / u_orders

features.name: up_days_since_last
features.formula: days from the latest order of the user with the product to A (fractional, from seconds)
features.missing: NULL when the user never bought the product

features.name: up_mean_interval
features.formula: (time of the latest minus time of the earliest order of the user with the product) / (up_orders - 1), in days

features.name: up_due
features.formula: up_days_since_last / up_mean_interval
features.missing: NULL when either is NULL or up_mean_interval = 0

features.name: up_qty_total
features.formula: sum of quantity over all lines of the product of the user before A, repeated lines included

features.name: up_last_price
features.formula: price of the product line in the latest order of the user with the product (latest ts, then largest order_id; with several lines, the largest line_item_id)

features.name: up_discount_share
features.formula: mean of discount / (price + discount) over the lines of the product of the user with price + discount > 0 (negative discounts kept)
features.missing: NULL when there are no such lines

features.name: repeat_rank
features.formula: position of the product in the full repeat order of the user (source a, without its depth cut)
features.missing: NULL when the user never bought the product

features.name: popr_rank
features.formula: position of the product in the full pop-retailer order of the main retailer of the user (source b, without its depth cut)
features.missing: NULL when nobody bought the product at that retailer in the window

features.name: glob_rank
features.formula: position of the product in the full global order (source c)
features.missing: NULL when nobody bought the product in the window

features.name: u_orders
features.formula: number of distinct orders of the user before A

features.name: u_orders_28
features.formula: orders of the user in [A - 28 days, A)

features.name: u_days_since_last
features.formula: days from the latest order of the user to A

features.name: u_mean_basket
features.formula: mean over the orders of the user of the number of distinct products in the order

features.name: u_mean_gap
features.formula: (time of the latest minus time of the earliest order of the user) / (u_orders - 1), in days

features.name: u_main_share
features.formula: orders of the user at the main retailer / u_orders

features.name: p_buyers_28
features.formula: distinct users who bought the product in the global window of source c

features.name: p_buyers_28_main
features.formula: distinct users who bought the product at the main retailer of the user in the window of source b

features.name: p_repeat_share
features.formula: among users who bought the product in [A - 90 days, A), the share with at least 2 distinct orders containing it in that interval
features.missing: NULL when nobody bought it in the interval

features.name: uc_share
features.formula: orders of the user that contain a product of the same category as the product / u_orders; the category of a product is its non-NULL master_category_id in the history before A
features.missing: NULL when the product has no category; 0 when no such order

features.name: main_retailer
features.formula: code of the main retailer of the user (categorical)

features.name: up_orders_28
features.formula: number of distinct orders of the user in [A - 28 days, A) that contain the product

features.name: up_last5_share
features.formula: share of the last 5 orders of the user before A (by time descending, then order_id descending) that contain the product; the denominator is min(5, u_orders)

features.name: up_in_last_order
features.formula: 1 when the latest order of the user before A (latest time, then largest order_id) contains the product, else 0

features.name: up_days_since_first
features.formula: days from the earliest order of the user with the product to A (fractional, from seconds)
features.missing: NULL when the user never bought the product

features.name: p_buyers_7
features.formula: distinct users who bought the product over all orders in [A - 7 days, A)

features.name: p_trend
features.formula: p_buyers_7 / p_buyers_28

features.name: p_buyers_28_main_share
features.formula: p_buyers_28_main / p_buyers_28

features.name: up_qty_mean
features.formula: up_qty_total / number of lines of the product of the user before A (repeated lines included)
features.missing: NULL when there are no such lines

features.name: uc_days_since_last
features.formula: days from the latest order of the user with a line of a product of the same category as the product to A (fractional, from seconds); categories as in uc_share
features.missing: NULL when the product has no category or there is no such order
